name: pimatrix
description: Raspberry Pi video routing and processing control plane

scripts.build: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm --filter @pimatrix/api-client run build && pnpm --filter @pimatrix/api run build && pnpm --filter @pimatrix/cli run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pimatrix/api run test && pnpm --filter @pimatrix/cli run test
scripts.lab:logs: docker compose -f dev/streaming-lab/compose.yaml logs -f mediamtx test-patterns
